findings.problem: Imperative with a definite clitic (Créa-lo) has no antecedent in a card heading; the two sibling route headings are infinitives ("Vincular uno que ya existe", "Usar una dirección"), so the three routes read in different moods. English 'one' is indefinite.

findings.current: Esta app controla las sesiones de tu propia máquina, así que esa máquina tiene que ejecutar un conector y mantenerse activa. Tu código no sale de ella.
findings.problem: 'stay awake' rendered 'mantenerse activa'; 'activa' is the catalogue's connected-status badge (mobile.computers.badge.active) and the billing state word, and the catalogue already renders 'stay awake' as not entering sleep (own_tunnel.step_computer_help 'Evita que entre en reposo').
findings.suggested: Esta app controla las sesiones de tu propia máquina, así que esa máquina tiene que ejecutar un conector y no entrar en reposo. Tu código no sale de ella.

findings.problem: 'un terminal' (masculine) is correct but the core es catalogue uses feminine 'la terminal' 7 times vs 'un terminal' once; feminine also reads more neutral across LatAm.

rulings.Vincular (attach_label, attach_title, at: ACCEPT — natural for joining an existing resource; avoids colliding with 'conectar' used on ran_it; also reads well in copy hint 'Copia el comando “Vincular”'.
rulings.ID del túnel: ACCEPT — 'ID' is the settled es UI term; 12 chars in a field label is fine.
rulings.cadena de consulta: ACCEPT — standard Spanish web term for query string; 'fragmento' likewise.
rulings.la TUI: ACCEPT — TUI is on the style guide's kept-English list; feminine matches core es catalogue (9 occurrences of la/de la TUI, none masculine).
rulings.«Vuelve a buscar tus máquinas»: ACCEPT — describes what discovery does (re-reading the account's computers) in plain words; no settled es term for 'discovery' in the catalogues.
rulings.«renovar su sesión»: ACCEPT — 're-mint' = issue a new session token; 'renovar la sesión' is the faithful plain rendering; 'su' mirrors English 'its'.
rulings.ran_it past tense «Ya lo ejecuté: conect: ACCEPT — pretérito is the neutral choice (LatAm standard, fully natural in Spain); 23 chars < English 24; colon is cleaner than an em dash in a button.
rulings.your_computer «Tu máquina»: ACCEPT value — matches catalogue term 'máquina'; mid-sentence lowercase is a known CODE item, not ruled against the draft.

read_route: ordinary git/scratchpad reads; read_public_copy not used (core route refuses mobile catalogue paths); context sidecars are nested JSON and not routable
